definition: Train all four candidates on training data.
Score all candidates on validation data.
Select one candidate using the specified validation objective.
Freeze its threshold according to the specified policy.
Evaluate once on held-out test data.
adaptive_top1_policy.prohibition: No test label, test score, test metric, or test ranking may influence the selection.

best_fixed_baseline.deployment_warning: Must not be treated as a validation-selected deployment rule unless a separate validation-only baseline-selection mechanism is defined.
selection_rules: From the four fixed candidates only.
For descriptive summary after all candidate results are available.

contract_title: Scientific Analysis Contract for Major Revision

brier.practical_interpretation: Mean squared error of predicted probabilities, reflects calibration.

avg_precision.practical_interpretation: Area under precision-recall curve, threshold-free ranking quality.

lift_at_10pct.practical_interpretation: Ratio of precision@10% to baseline defect rate.

precision_at_10pct.practical_interpretation: Precision when inspecting top 10% of risky instances.

recall_at_10pct.practical_interpretation: Defect coverage when inspecting top 10% of risky instances.

balanced_accuracy.practical_interpretation: Average of recall across both classes.

f1.practical_interpretation: Harmonic mean of precision and recall.

mcc.practical_interpretation: Balanced measure for binary classification, robust to class imbalance.

precision.practical_interpretation: Diagnostic metric, must not be interpreted without threshold policy.

recall.practical_interpretation: Diagnostic metric, must not be interpreted without threshold policy.

lift_at_20pct.practical_interpretation: Ratio of precision@20% to baseline defect rate.

precision_at_20pct.practical_interpretation: Precision when inspecting top 20% of risky instances.

recall_at_20pct.practical_interpretation: Defect coverage when inspecting top 20% of risky instances.

roc_auc.practical_interpretation: Area under ROC curve, threshold-free ranking quality. Secondary because precision-recall is more informative under imbalance.

balanced_policy.description: Candidate ranking by balanced validation objective, threshold selected by balanced validation objective.

mcc_policy.description: Candidate ranking by validation MCC objective, threshold selected by validation MCC objective.

rank_plus_validation_threshold_policy.description: Candidate ranking by rank objective, after candidate or ensemble selection, threshold is tuned on validation only. This policy is a planned sensitivity analysis and must not replace or silently overwrite the existing score-only rank policy.

rank_score_only_policy.description: Candidate ranking by rank objective, primary interpretation restricted to threshold-free and top-k metrics, thresholded metrics are diagnostic only when threshold is fixed at 0.5.
rank_score_only_policy.primary_interpretation: Restricted to threshold-free and top-k metrics.
rank_score_only_policy.thresholded_metrics_status: diagnostic only when threshold is fixed at 0.5

key_assertions: Oracle is not a deployable model.
Oracle uses test information only for retrospective analysis.
Oracle values must never feed candidate selection, threshold selection, ensemble construction, or model fitting.

oracle_computation.higher_is_better: oracle_value = maximum test value among the four fixed candidates
oracle_computation.lower_is_better: oracle_value = minimum test value among the four fixed candidates

oracle_and_regret_policy.regret_property: Regret must always be non-negative up to floating-point tolerance.
separate_records: Selected candidate in oracle winner set.

prohibited_claims: AQRPE v2 is a fundamentally new algorithm.
Validation-based model selection is itself a novel contribution.
Soft averaging of top models is itself a novel contribution.
Train/validation/test separation is itself an algorithmic contribution.
Five seeds are five independent datasets.
Twenty-five project-seed runs are twenty-five independent projects.
The test oracle is a deployable selection method.
Test data may influence selection or threshold tuning.
remaining_stage_roadmap: Part 3B: Prediction ledger and split/leakage audit
Part 3C: Objective-matched candidate and adaptive evaluation
Part 3D: Post-hoc regret and oracle-gap analysis
Part 3G: Project-level paired effects and uncertainty
Part 3H: Workflow diagram and metric dictionary
Part 4: Final full rerun, deterministic artifact freeze, package rebuild, and canonical manifest

rq1.exact_intent: How do the four fixed candidate learners, validation-selected adaptive Top-1 variants, and validation-constructed soft ensembles compare under repeated within-project and cross-project evaluation?
requirements: No post-hoc selection of a favorable comparison only.
Separate interpretation for within-project and cross-project settings.
rq1.title: Comparative performance

rq2.exact_intent: How do model rankings and conclusions change across discrimination, thresholded classification, early-inspection ranking, and calibration-sensitive metrics?
requirements: No single metric defines an overall winner.
Ranking metrics, thresholded metrics, and calibration metrics represent different operational goals.
All other retained metrics are maximized.
rq2.title: Metric-dependent trade-offs

rq3.exact_intent: How frequently and how stably are candidates selected across projects and seeds, and how well do validation rankings agree with held-out test rankings?
required_analyses: Explicit statement that these are descriptive analyses, not proof of superiority.
rq3.title: Selection behavior and stability

rq4.exact_intent: What do post-hoc regret and controlled ablation reveal about the value of adaptive Top-1 selection, Soft-top-2, Soft-top-3, and Soft-all-4 relative to fixed candidates and an oracle reference?
requirements: Oracle best candidate on test used only as a post-hoc analytical reference.
No use of test information for actual model selection.
rq4.title: Regret, ensemble size, and ablation

reviewer_2_focus: Threats to validity require deeper analysis.
Limitations and future directions must be evidence-based.
reviewer_3_focus: Repeated seeds and leakage control are good practice, not algorithmic novelty.
The paper should be treated as a careful empirical study rather than a new fundamental algorithm.

reviewer_1_comment_2.manuscript_response: Key finding paragraph before every results table

reviewer_1_comment_3.computational_response: Deterministic workflow figure in later Part 3H

reviewer_2_comment_5.computational_response: Final limitations grounded in completed analyses

reviewer_3.scientific_response: Reposition the study as a controlled empirical evaluation rather than a fundamentally novel algorithm.

key_assertions: Soft averaging is standard ensemble methodology.
Repeated seeds and train/validation/test separation are experimental controls.
The scientific contribution is empirical characterization and controlled evidence, not the invention of a fundamentally new learning algorithm.
No result may be framed as universal dominance.
Conclusions must remain dataset-, metric-, setting-, and protocol-dependent.
scientific_positioning.positioning_statement: A validation-controlled empirical study of model selection behavior, metric-dependent trade-offs, selection stability, validation-test agreement, post-hoc regret, and soft-ensemble ablation for imbalanced software defect prediction under repeated within-project and cross-project evaluation.

sensitivity_analysis_policy.dataset_change_policy: Changing the five benchmark projects is outside the current computational revision unless new verified datasets are introduced under a separate protocol.

balanced_objective_weights.description: Current weights, equal-weight alternative, predefined weight perturbations.

cross_project_validation_design.description: Current stratified source-row split, source-project-aware validation robustness check.

definition: Rank candidates using validation scores only.
Select the top k candidates using a deterministic tie policy.
Average their defective-class probabilities with equal weights.
Tune the ensemble threshold using validation data only.
Freeze selected membership, order, weights, and threshold.
key_assertions: Equal weighting is the primary ensemble rule.
Learned weights are outside the current study scope.
Soft-top-3 must not be treated as privileged before the ablation is complete.
If Soft-top-3 does not outperform Soft-all-4 or Soft-top-2 consistently, the manuscript must report that result directly.
soft_ensemble_policy.soft_all_4_note: Soft-all-4 includes all four candidates and therefore does not involve membership selection, but its threshold must still be tuned on validation only.

stage_gate.part3b_constraint: Part 3B cannot alter the current 400 canonical result rows or current canonical manuscript tables unless a later explicitly approved migration stage is created.

effect_reporting: Rank-biserial effect size or another predeclared paired effect size.
key_assertions: No multiple-comparison-adjusted confirmatory family is claimed.
No inferential superiority claim is authorized.
Conclusions must emphasize direction, magnitude, consistency, and limitations.
permitted_exploratory_inference: Exact Wilcoxon signed-rank test at project level only.
Only when the assumptions and zero-difference handling are explicitly stated.
No binary accept/reject conclusion based only on p-values.
required_descriptive_reporting: Five raw project-level paired differences when space permits.

conclusion_validity.planned_computational_response: Emphasize descriptive over inferential, report effect sizes.
conclusion_validity.remaining_limitation: N=5 is small for strong inference.

conclusion_validity.current_mitigation: Project as primary unit, seed as nested replication.
conclusion_validity.planned_computational_response: Strict unit-of-analysis policy, no seed-level inference.

conclusion_validity.possible_impact: Type II errors, missed real differences.
conclusion_validity.remaining_limitation: Small N limits detection of small effects.

conclusion_validity.planned_computational_response: Metric-by-metric interpretation, no global superiority claim.
conclusion_validity.remaining_limitation: No unified metric family-wise error control.

conclusion_validity.current_mitigation: Clear labeling of descriptive vs exploratory inference.

conclusion_validity.possible_impact: Results may change under different validation schemes.
conclusion_validity.threat: Sensitivity to objective weights and validation design

construct_validity.possible_impact: Different metrics may rank models differently.
construct_validity.remaining_limitation: No single metric captures all operational goals.

construct_validity.planned_computational_response: Sensitivity analysis on threshold policy in Part 3F.
construct_validity.possible_impact: Thresholded metrics sensitive to threshold choice.
construct_validity.remaining_limitation: Threshold policy may favor certain methods.

construct_validity.planned_computational_response: Report results for multiple k values.
construct_validity.possible_impact: Precision@k and recall@k depend on inspection budget.
construct_validity.remaining_limitation: Results may not generalize to other budgets.

construct_validity.possible_impact: Models may excel at one but not the other.

construct_validity.planned_computational_response: Clear oracle framing in all reporting.
construct_validity.possible_impact: Oracle may be misinterpreted as achievable target.
construct_validity.remaining_limitation: Oracle is not a deployable method.

external_validity.planned_computational_response: Explicit limitation statement, no universal claims.
external_validity.possible_impact: Results may not generalize to other datasets.
external_validity.remaining_limitation: Small number of datasets, all from same domain.

external_validity.possible_impact: Results may not apply to process or change metrics.
external_validity.remaining_limitation: Static metrics may not capture dynamic defect patterns.

external_validity.possible_impact: Data may not reflect modern software development.
Results may not extend to other learner types.
external_validity.remaining_limitation: Limited hyperparameter search, no deep learning.

internal_validity.current_mitigation: Strict train/validation/test splits, leakage audit in Part 3B.
internal_validity.possible_impact: Inflated performance due to test information contaminating training.
internal_validity.remaining_limitation: Complex preprocessing pipelines may have subtle leakage.

internal_validity.current_mitigation: Preprocessing fitted on training fold only.
internal_validity.remaining_limitation: Need to verify all preprocessing steps.
Some library components may have nondeterministic behavior.

internal_validity.planned_computational_response: Report tie frequency and impact in Part 3C.
internal_validity.possible_impact: Selection instability when scores are equal.
internal_validity.remaining_limitation: Near ties may still cause instability.

internal_validity.possible_impact: Unfair comparisons using different threshold policies.
internal_validity.remaining_limitation: Policy mismatches may still occur in exploratory analyses.

internal_validity.planned_computational_response: Distinguish pre-specified from exploratory in reporting.
internal_validity.remaining_limitation: Exploratory analyses may still be selective.

tie_policy.scientific_analysis_rule: For scientific analysis, all exact tied winners must be preserved in the winner set even if one deterministic candidate is used operationally.
validation_candidate_ranking: Use a tolerance of 1e-12 only for reporting near ties.
Do not merge non-transitive chains of near-equal values.
If exact scores are equal, use the following deterministic candidate order: LR_std_C0.1, LR_std_C1, DT_leaf5, ET_leaf5.

prohibitions: Treating 25 project-seed runs as 25 fully independent projects.
Using seed-level p-values as primary superiority evidence.
Claiming general population-level significance from five projects.
project_level_paired_summaries: First aggregate the five seeds within each project.
Then compare methods across the five projects.

repeated_seed.definition: Within-project replication nested inside a project.
not: A valid substitute for additional datasets.

run_level_observations_must_not_be_used_: Fully independent observations for significance claims.

explicit_statements: Low agreement does not by itself prove the validation procedure is invalid.
High agreement does not prove predictive superiority.
Undefined rank correlations must remain missing, never substituted with zero.
All test-based agreement is retrospective analysis only.
required_agreement_analyses: Selected candidate in test winner set.
